note: Source of the agent cats of the factory mod. Traced on 2026-11-17 from six images the maintainer generated (one per role). Coordinates are in a 1024 by 1024 space. Draw order of a figure: silhouette (fill body, stroke outline), collar (fill collar), bell, objectFill, ink (fill ink, fill-rule evenodd), then the eyes and the marks of the state.

needs.glow: magenta, a tenth of the size

badge.note: Under 32 px the head crop is used and the object is this badge, at translate(598 504) scale(1.15): a circle of radius 100 filled with body and stroked with ink (width 12), then the icon of the role. {{c.ink}} is the ink colour, {{halo}} is #ffffff (none for the reviewer) and {{notch}} is #ffffff (#15161c for the reviewer).
